messages:
alex_h: Heads-up — opening a docs PR to add a tiny Dedicated provisioning quickstart (YAML sample + autoscale examples). Need quick eyeballs on API names and SLA wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234

maria_t: Nice. Can you also include a terse terraform/terragrunt migration snippet? And can we clarify SLA language around preemption vs eviction (one-liner)?

sarah_docs: I can review wording. Can you paste the YAML and any SDK snippet here so I can check formatting before I pull the PR locally?

alex_h: Sure — pasted minimal sample below. Intentionally tiny so it’s easy to copy:
```yaml
kind: DedicatedCapacity
metadata:
  name: small-reserved-pool
spec:
  gpu_type: a100-80gb
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 4
  burst_capacity: 2 # short bursts allowed
  tenancy: isolated
```

ben_platform: Quick note: prefer `tenant_isolation: true` field name in docs (maps to our API `isolation: tenant`). Also call out that `min_replicas` is a soft floor for autoscale under constrained capacity. Add a short sentence about warm cache behavior.

jamal: For migration: add a CLI snippet that maps old tenant tag to new reserved pool label. Something like:
```bash
# migration: map old tenant -> reserved pool
redwoodctl tenants migrate --from-tag legacy-team --to-reserved small-reserved-pool
```

alex_h: Adding tiny SDK example for creation (JS):
```js
await redwood.dedicated.create({
  name: 'small-reserved-pool',
  gpu_type: 'a100-80gb',
  autoscale: { min_replicas: 1, max_replicas: 4, burst: 2 }
});
```

sarah_docs: Wording nit: replace `tenancy: isolated` with `tenant_isolation: true` and in the prose call it "tenant isolation (prevents noisy neighbors; not a full hardware guarantee)". Also link to handbook: https://redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/isolation

maria_t: Also the SLA paragraph currently says "best-effort eviction" which is confusing. Suggest: "SLA covers availability for reserved capacity; preemption events are possible for lower tiers — Dedicated reserved pools will not be preempted under normal operations; see SLA table for exact conditions." I'll paste a short sentence in the PR. Also update outdated SLA matrix link to: https://confluence.redwood.ai/sla-matrix/v2

deploy-bot: CI: docs-lint ✅ for PR #1234 — no broken links detected.

ben_platform: I'll review the autoscale edge-case where request volume is low but KV cache is warm; should we add a short note recommending `min_replicas: 2` for latency-sensitive workloads? I'll leave a comment in the PR.

alex_h: Assigning reviewers @sarah_docs and @ben_platform. Target merge: EOD Friday if no blockers. Question for the group: should we include a small "cost estimate" snippet (ballpark $/hour at different replica counts) or keep cost out of quickstart?

sarah_docs: :thumbsup: add a one-row ballpark table (estimate only) — I'll draft a single-line table and keep it high-level.

jamal: FYI migration script also needs to update tenant mapping labels; I'll open a tiny follow-up PR to add the CLI sample so docs and CLI match.

alex_h: Thanks all — I'll incorporate these fixes and ping again once I push updates.
